usage: 大姐 is used to refer to the eldest sister in a family.
When talking about siblings, 大姐 specifically means the oldest female sibling.
You can use 大姐 as a polite way to address or mention your eldest sister.
In conversations, 大姐 often implies respect because of the elder position.
It can also be used affectionately to refer to an older sister among close friends.
